## Add Go, Rust, C, Lua language backends (tree-sitter symbols + references,… — 2026-07-29 (parent 6feb14aa9e51)

Four new language backends are added — `GoBackend` (`trie/parse/go`), `RustBackend` (`trie/parse/rust`), `CBackend` (`trie/parse/c`), and `LuaBackend` (`trie/parse/lua`) — each implementing tree-sitter symbol/reference extraction paired with a language server (gopls, rust-analyzer, clangd, lua-language-server respectively). The existing `TypeScriptBackend` is extended to also handle JavaScript (`.js`/`.jsx`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`) via parser selection and suffix stripping in `_make_parser` and `_module_key`.

`LspServerSpec` gains `init_timeout` and `warmup` fields; `LspResolver._client_for` and `_resolve_file_inner` thread these through so heavier servers get handshake and settle time. Corresponding specs (`GO_SPEC`, `RUST_SPEC`, `C_SPEC`, `LUA_SPEC`) and call-site selectors are added in `trie/parse/resolvers/specs`. `_build_registry` registers all four backends with optional imports so a missing grammar skips silently. A new test module `tests/test_backends_multilang` covers symbol kinds, visibility, and call edges for every new backend plus the JS-via-TS path.

- + tests/test_backends_multilang:test_go_symbols_and_calls — "Verify the Go backend correctly extracts symbol kinds (`function`, `class`, `method`, `constant`) and emits a `calls` edge from `Counter.Inc` to `Add`."
- + tests/test_backends_multilang:test_javascript_uses_typescript_backend — "Assert that `.js` files are routed to `TypeScriptBackend` and that it correctly extracts symbols with stripped-suffix qualified names."
